LICENSES
=======

本目录（Examples/pascal/）下各来源文件所适用的许可文本全文。
文件 → 许可 的对应关系见同目录 CREDITS.md。

[3] 2-clause BSD（SWAG 归档默认）—— 适用于 swag_*
========================================================================

The code snippets in this archive are generally freeware or public domain
as defined by their accompanying comments and copyrights. Any content
without a specific license attached to it is considered to be licensed
under the 2-clause BSD license.

(The 2-clause BSD text above applies, with <YEAR>/<OWNER> taken from each
snippet's own header comment.)

NOTE (from the archive's own LICENSE file):
* The original webswag.rar suggested that the default license should be the GPL,
  but this seems to be an arbitrary choice by the original packager, and counter
  to the public domain spirit of SWAG.
